description.text: A starter set and the first release of cards from the XY Series, out in German on 8 November 2013, the same day as in English and Japanese. Its 39 cards came in three theme decks built around the Kalos first partner Pokémon Chespin, Fennekin and Froakie.

tell.text: The Kalos Starter Set symbol at the bottom right, and a number out of 39
